description: This file defines the TimesheetSearchFilterParams class in the OrangeHRM Time module. It encapsulates filtering parameters for searching timesheets, including date ranges and employee number, extending a base FilterParams class.

classes.name: TimesheetSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class used to specify search filter parameters for timesheet queries, such as date range and employee number.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the starting date filter for the timesheet search, nullable DateTime.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the starting date filter for the timesheet search.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the ending date filter for the timesheet search, nullable DateTime.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the ending date filter for the timesheet search.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the timesheet search.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for the timesheet search.
